blocks.explanation: The same institutional architecture read through the persistence lens: individual organisms are transient realizations of a larger persistent informational architecture, and civilizations persist by preserving values, transmitting knowledge, coordinating institutions, adapting technology and expanding habitats. The canonical stack rises from human values through knowledge and methodology, domain programmes, technology and implementation, habitat expansion, to the perpetuation of civilization, and each layer is given a thermodynamic reading — values define the boundary constraints that minimize variational free energy, Zistgah maintains the macro-environmental steady state, Project Vikram executes the state-space transformations, AAB defines the metric tensor of the civilizational manifold, and ILM minimizes prediction error through recursive learning. The closing interpretation is the poster's point: the primary object of persistence is not the individual but the persistence of organized human capability — values, knowledge, institutions, technology, habitats — in which individuals participate while the structures extend beyond any single lifetime.
